adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
adds.text: Groot helps threaten Yondu's ship to get Quill and Gamora back, then joins the plan Quill makes with Yondu's Ravagers to stop Ronan at Xandar.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager captain whose ship Groot helps threaten, then an ally against Ronan.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's partner, who helps threaten Yondu's ship, then fights with the Ravagers against Ronan.
adds.evidence: Rocket, Drax and Groot threaten to attack Yondu's ship (the Eclector) to rescue Quill and Gamora until Quill negotiates a truce; the Guardians then plan the attack with Yondu and his men on the Eclector and fight beside the Ravagers at Xandar.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
adds.text: Nebula blocks Groot and the others on Ronan's ship, cursing Gamora's betrayal, until Drax blasts her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ronan's ally, who blocks Groot's way on the Dark Aster.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: One of the group Nebula blocks on Ronan's ship.
adds.evidence: On the Dark Aster, Groot lights the way for Quill, Drax and Gamora when they are stopped by Nebula, who curses Gamora for betraying Ronan and Thanos; Drax shoots her. Fandom lists Nebula among the original Groot's enemies.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
adds.text: Rocket threatens to blow up the Ravagers' ship until Quill makes a deal with them. Over Xandar, Kraglin blasts a hole in Ronan's ship while Rocket fires beside him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A bounty hunter who threatens the Ravagers' ship, then fights beside Kraglin over Xandar.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Yondu's first mate, who blasts open Ronan's ship beside Rocket.
adds.evidence: Rocket fires on the Eclector and orders the Ravagers to release Quill and Gamora; after the deal the Guardians plan with Yondu's clan, and at Xandar Rocket fires at the Dark Aster with a few Ravagers while Kraglin does massive damage and makes the hole. Kraglin then joins Rocket and the Ravagers shooting down the Necrocraft.
